title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfond Arena, U of Maine on 1983-04-19
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. January 2012
source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300 w/CP1 cardioids > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90s, floor, left of the soundboard (stage right), taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Fair-quality recording hampered by harsh highs; the show is uneven and fairly average for ’83
ai_review.review: The performance is described as patchy, sloppy, and uneven—about par for a 1983 concert—so listeners shouldn’t expect standout moments. The audio suffers from ringing high frequencies that require treble reduction, indicating only a fair‑quality source.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; it rates the show as average (3/5) and notes recording harshness, leading to a low‑average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Upper frequencies ring loudly; treble reduction recommended. No specific source type mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Uneven pacing with a generally sloppy, patchy performance typical of the 1983 era.
